verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity is an identity-verification API/SaaS product, not an agent or agent-orchestration platform; the story of 'plugging MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools' applies to agentic products that consume external tools, not verification services. The only MCP-related evidence shows Stripe exposes its own MCP server for AI agents to call the Stripe API (server role), which is the inverse of this client-side story and doesn't make this axis applicable.
